blocks.heading: Solving
lines: Factor: x² − 5x − 14 = (x − 7)(x + 2), so the roots are 7 and −2.

blocks.heading: Discriminant
lines: D > 0: two different real roots. D = 0: equal roots. D < 0: no real roots.
x² − 8x + k has equal roots when 64 − 4k = 0, so k = 16.

blocks.heading: Sum and product of roots
lines: For ax² + bx + c = 0: sum = −b/a, product = c/a.
Equation from roots p and q: x² − (p + q)x + pq = 0.

blocks.heading: Maximum and minimum
lines: ax² + bx + c turns at x = −b/2a.
a > 0 gives a minimum. a < 0 gives a maximum.
x² − 6x + 13 = (x − 3)² + 4, so the minimum is 4 at x = 3.
